nodes.label: JWT Token Management
nodes.rationale: Automatic token storage/refresh/cleanup via AsyncStorage and interceptors avoids requiring any backend changes while keeping sessions valid and secure.

nodes.label: Role-Based Authentication (delivery_person only)
nodes.rationale: Login must be restricted to role === 'delivery_person' with account approved/not deleted, enforced both server-side and client-side, so the delivery driver app cannot be used by other user types even though it shares the backend with other apps.

nodes.label: Meal Time Auto-Detection Logic
nodes.rationale: Current meal time (breakfast/lunch/dinner) is derived automatically from time-of-day so the home screen defaults to today's relevant orders without the driver manually selecting a meal filter.

nodes.label: Smart Caching (2-minute order cache)
nodes.rationale: Orders are cached for only 2 minutes (shorter than areas' 5 minutes) because order/payment data changes far more frequently than area lists; falls back to cached data on API error to keep the UI usable offline.

nodes.label: Area Caching (5-minute cache)
nodes.rationale: Areas rarely change, so a longer 5-minute cache reduces API calls; falls back to cached data on error and supports manual refresh/clear.

nodes.label: Dead-code isLoggedIn gate bug
nodes.rationale: app/_layout.tsx's isLoggedIn gate is never set to true; real navigation happens via ad hoc router.push calls from the login screen instead, mirroring the same known bug in Frontend-Customer.

nodes.label: Layered Services Architecture
nodes.rationale: Splitting config/types/utils/clients/auth/hooks into distinct layers keeps API concerns, business logic, and React state management separately testable and consistent across every backend integration in the app.
